rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket covers the refactoring of the `DrawIOXMLTree` class into a new `DrawIOParser` class in `gbad_core/drawio.py`. The new class will encapsulate the core parsing logic and will return a structured representation of the graph.
rdf:Description.skos:scopeNote: **Relevant Code Snippets:** ```python @dataclass(frozen=True) class DrawIOXMLTree: # ... def individuals_and_arrows( self, strict_mode: bool, max_gap: float) -> Generator[ Individual | Arrow, None, None]: """ Returns as a generator all Individual and Arrow instances obtained when parsing the nodes and arrows of the draw.io XML graph fed into the DrawIOXMLTree instance upon its construction """ # ... ```
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan:** 1. **Create `DrawIOParser` Class in `gbad_core/drawio.py`:** - Define the `DrawIOParser` class. - The `__init__` method will accept the Draw.io XML content as a string and an instance of `DrawIOParserConfig`. 2. **Move and Refactor `__post_init__`:** - The logic from `DrawIOXMLTree.__post_init__` will be moved to the `DrawIOParser.__init__` method. This includes parsing the raw XML string and calling a private method (e.g., `_extract_cells`) to populate lists of individual, arrow, and literal cells. 3. **Implement `parse()` Method:** - Create a `parse()` method that mirrors the functionality of the old `individuals_and_arrows` method. - This method will iterate through the lists of cells, call the appropriate parsing methods (e.g., `_parse_individual`, `_parse_arrow`), and yield `Individual` and `Arrow` objects from `gbad_core.models`. 4. **Refactor Helper Methods as Private Methods:** - All the helper methods from `DrawIOXMLTree` (e.g., `_cell_with_id`, `_value_of`, `_geometry`, `_arrow_start`, `_arrow_end`, `_dimensions`, `_close_enough`, `_cell_close_to`, `_source_or_target`, `_arrow`) will be moved into `DrawIOParser` as private methods (e.g., `_get_cell_by_id`, `_get_value`).
